mainEntity.name: How much do coolroom repairs cost in Parramatta?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most coolroom and cold room repairs cost $250 to $900, plus a call-out fee of about $100 to $250. Gas leaks, condensing units and compressors can cost more and are quoted after we inspect the room. You get a fixed quote before we start.

mainEntity.name: Do you repair freezer rooms as well as coolrooms?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We repair walk-in coolrooms, cold rooms and freezer rooms. Freezer rooms add defrost heaters, door-frame heaters and colder-running gear, so we quote them on what we find.

mainEntity.name: Why is my coolroom not getting cold?

acceptedAnswer.text: The usual causes are a dirty or failed condensing unit fan, ice blocking the evaporator, a worn door seal or strip curtain letting warm air in, a faulty controller or probe, or low refrigerant from a leak. A technician tests each one in turn.

mainEntity.name: What temperature should a coolroom be?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cold food should be kept at 5°C or below, so most coolrooms run a few degrees under that. If your room is holding above 5°C, move high-risk food such as meat, dairy and seafood to a working fridge or a cooler with ice and book a repair.

mainEntity.name: Why is there ice on my coolroom evaporator?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ice usually means the defrost system has failed, the door is not sealing, or the drain is blocked. Melting the ice only helps for a while. We find why it formed and repair that part.
